title: SplitMix64 generator
summary: Proves that the compiled SplitMix64 step and the conversion of its word to a float in [0, 1) compute their Lean definitions and keep the store, in any module whose function list contains them.
premises: The module's function list holds the compiled splitMix or unitFloat at index i, as prng.splitMix.ir or prng.unitFloat.ir with its name
result: ImplementsPure at entry 3 + i, which Stmt.callPure_spec turns into a Triple for a call from a loop body or any other code that must keep the store.
